mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL increases by more than 2% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past month indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE drops by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months signals a strengthening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the periods with sustained increases in HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate falls below 2% quarter-over-quarter, it indicates a tightening monetary policy in a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and GDPC1 growth < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO drops by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points over the past month, it signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE drops by more than 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strong consumer demand, which is a positive indicator for economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% annualized, it indicates a deflationary environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL < 2%.
